def pc (i j k : Nat) (x : List Nat) : Int :=

Conversely a 0/1 solution w gives x = w, which takes values {0,1} (exactly two values because each clause contains a 0 and a 1). Hence the set of GF(3) solutions using at most two values is nonempty exactly when F is positive 1-in-3 satisfiable.
